source.quote: As of July 31, 2026, there were approximately 11,600 holders of record of shares of Class A Common Stock and 300 holders of record of shares of Class B Common Stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: its Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no shares of News Corp (no issuer row containing "NEWS"), so calpers is null. Holders of record: Class A (NWSA) only; Class B has approximately 300 holders of record.
